prompt: At the most fundamental level, an LLM like ChatGPT is best described as:
choices: A search engine indexed in real time
A statistical pattern matcher trained to predict the next token in a sequence
A symbolic reasoner like classical AI
A database of facts curated by humans

prompt: What does it mean when an LLM 'hallucinates'?
choices: Its hardware is malfunctioning
It produces plausible-sounding output that isn't grounded in fact and presents it confidently
It refuses to answer a question
It outputs random letters

prompt: Which is the safest practice when an LLM gives you a specific citation or statistic?
choices: Trust it — citations are usually fetched from a verified database
Treat it as a guess until you have verified it against a primary source
Cite it as authoritative without checking
Ask the model again — agreement on a second try guarantees accuracy

prompt: Which prompting technique tends to produce the largest quality improvement in practical use?
choices: Adding emojis to the prompt
Few-shot prompting — showing the model 1–3 examples of the format you want
Always asking in capital letters
Asking the same question many times in a row

prompt: Which instruction does an LLM tend to honour most reliably?
choices: Format instructions like 'three bullet points, each under 15 words'
Instructions to 'always be 100% accurate'
Instructions to invent new facts that don't exist
Instructions to forget its training

prompt: Which is the most accurate framing of AI's impact on work in 2026?
choices: AI is replacing entire job categories within months
AI is replacing specific tasks within roles rather than most jobs wholesale; roles that involve human trust, novel physical work, or high-end creative judgement are slowest to change
AI has had essentially no measurable effect on work yet
AI only affects engineering jobs

prompt: What is a reasonable default privacy assumption when using a consumer cloud AI tool?
choices: Whatever you paste is private by default and cannot be retained
Anything you paste may be retained and potentially used for training; sensitive data should not be pasted into consumer tools
Indian users are exempt from data retention
Only voice input is retained — typed input is not

prompt: Why do LLMs trained on internet text exhibit bias against minority groups, certain dialects, or genders?
choices: The hardware introduces random bias
Models inherit the patterns of their training data, which over-represents certain perspectives and reproduces stereotypes baked into that data
Engineers deliberately encode bias
There is no measurable bias in modern LLMs
